implementation_choices.a: probe set: the selected C only (D-332 (1); D-346 (2)(a))
implementation_choices.b: P-A3.1 cells: pair x pool x attacker x rho with the pool's score-level repair (threshold re-set on R_same and R_fresh, quantile transfer on traffic); restandardisation is not predicted by P-A3.1 (its threshold is T_d on restandardised scores, not an order statistic; D-221 P4) and is scored by P-A3.4 (D-332 (5)). On the 32 threshold re-set cells of 48 (about two thirds) the prediction is the repair's own rule on the same pool, so they agree by construction up to ties at the k-th place. D-332's 1% rule is not quantile transfer's rule on traffic: the transfer carries the clean pre window's tail share at T_d (its harmful items included) to the poisoned post window, so its threshold sits below t' and the traffic cells are expected to be under-predicted
implementation_choices.c: F1bar(t) = share of eval positives with post score >= t, the project's flag rule (paired.thr_at_fpr's exceedance; D-221's notation)
implementation_choices.d: k = int(math.floor(alpha * (n + m))) (equal to the largest c with c/(n+m) <= alpha on the grid, tested); the k-th largest counts ties with multiplicity (np.sort(x)[N - k]) (D-242: whole items)
implementation_choices.e: A3-benign ranked by the seed-mean post score with 4d B's A1 expression np.argsort(-mean) (D-244 (4))
implementation_choices.f: A3-benign candidates: every probe_train negative, as D-332 (3) names them; each seed's fit rows are among them (F-060, D-221). A confound with a direction (D-352 (2), rule 5): the fit rows are 80% of probe_train (D-117's 20% hold-out aside), so about 80% of the candidates are, per seed, that seed's own fit rows, which score low under the probe fitted on them (why F-045 / F-060 keep fit rows out of every 4d pool); this weakens A3-benign and biases P-A3.2 toward holding. The realised share among the injected items is recorded per seed (benign_fit_row_share_per_seed)
implementation_choices.g: a cell's prediction is the D-156 mean over the 200 draws of the per-draw mean over seeds, frozen split beside (D-156; D-346 (4))
implementation_choices.h: the injections (first round(0.25 n) items per pool and draw for A3-top, per pair for A3-benign) are stored in the npz and bound bit for bit by the simulation
implementation_choices.i: the four repairs are poolstudy_d156.main()'s recal, quantile and feature code paths and A3-top its A1 expression, so the self-anchor can hold bit for bit (D-332 (1), (6); D-244 (5))
implementation_choices.j: health ratio: healthcheck_d156.health with cal_d's pre scores against the pool's post scores at T_d for every pool (D-332 (3) 'the pool's post moments against the pre moments'; D-241 (1)-(2); the defender holds no pre model for fresh items, D-318 (9)); the direct ratio is not reported
implementation_choices.k: A3-band: candidates in A3-top's order; at each step the highest-ranked remaining candidate whose addition leaves the pool's Gaussian ratio strictly inside (0.5, 2) (also when the clean pool's ratio was outside); a non-fitting candidate stays available; one greedy per draw and pool to rho 0.25's budget, nested over rho; a one-step moment update screens, health() decides near the edges and every item added
implementation_choices.l: A3-band's largest m = its realised m at rho 0.25 (the budget caps it at 250)
implementation_choices.m: P-A3.3 per pool and repair: A3-top at A3-band's per-draw largest m; D-156 mean of per-draw TPR losses; strict '<'; a cell with A3-band's m = 0 in every draw is None, not False (band infeasible: the clean pool already crosses the 4c cut, or no harmful item keeps the pool inside; the reason is recorded); the pair verdict (D-351 (3)'s reading) is False if any decided cell fails, True if every decided cell holds and at least one is decided, None if none is decided; beside each cell, not the verdict, the clean pool's Gaussian flag share and the loss comparison over only the draws with m > 0; the infeasible cells whose clean pool flags in every draw are listed as a finding (D-352 (2): the band admits no attacker where 4c already fires on the clean pool)
implementation_choices.n: P-A3.2 per pool and repair, restandardisation included (P-A3.1 takes only the score repair); None reads '> 0.25' (D-244 (6)); a cell where both are '> 0.25' is undecided (None); the pair verdict is D-352 (3)'s reading (False if any decided cell fails, True if every decided cell holds and one is decided, else None); choice (f)'s fit-row confound biases it toward holding
implementation_choices.o: P-A3.4 per pair against each score repair (R_same, R_fresh, quantile transfer); '> 0.25' as in (n); relative tolerance 1e-9; a cell the grid cannot decide is None; the pair verdict is D-352 (3)'s reading as in (n); fully determined by A3-top, which equals 4d B's A1 values bit for bit (D-322 reports them): no new measurement
implementation_choices.p: D-282 combined TPR interval for every threshold-level arm clean and at every attacker and rho; not for restandardisation (D-346 (2)(j)); the same interval for every TPR loss reported on a threshold-level arm (each attacker's at its minimum rho, A3-band's and A3-top's at A3-band's largest m), paired within item and draw (the clean and the poisoned arm's flags on the same counts row)
implementation_choices.q: the lane log prints checks and verdict words only (D-346 (4))

P-A3.1.cells: pool x attacker (A3-top, A3-benign) x rho, the pool's score repair; realised and predicted TPR as cell D-156 means (the predictions record)

beside_quantile_transfer_cells_only.label: beside the registered line (accuracy, every cell): the quantile-transfer cells only, the cells where the prediction is not the repair's own rule

beside_threshold_reset_cells_only.label: beside the registered line (accuracy, every cell): the threshold re-set cells only, where agreement is mechanical (the prediction is the repair's own rule, up to ties at the k-th place)

P-A3.1.expectation: at least 80% of cells within x1.5 (D-332 (5)), over all pairs (pooled; not computed here). About two thirds of the cells (the threshold re-set cells, n_identity_cells of n_cells) agree mechanically: there the prediction is the repair's own rule on the same pool, equal up to ties at the k-th place (n_tied_at_k thresholds); the quantile-transfer cells, where D-332's 1% rule is not the repair's rule and the cells are expected to be under-predicted (choice (b)), are the line beside
P-A3.1.note: on the threshold re-set the prediction is the repair's own rule applied to the attacker's items, so those cells agree up to ties at the k-th place (the threshold identity check)

P-A3.2.rule: A3-benign's minimum rho >= A3-top's per pool and repair, restandardisation on traffic included (P-A3.1 takes only the score repair); None reads '> 0.25' (D-244 (6)); a cell where both are '> 0.25' is undecided (None); the pair verdict is D-352 (3)'s reading (D-351 (3)'s): False if any decided cell fails, True if every decided cell holds and at least one is decided, None if none is decided; a pair where it is lower is reported as a finding (D-332 (5)). A confound with a direction (choice (f), D-352 (2), rule 5): about 80% of A3-benign's candidates are each seed's own D-117 fit rows (the share among the injected items is benign_fit_row_share_per_seed), which score low under the probe fitted on them (F-045 / F-060 keep fit rows out of 4d's pools); this weakens A3-benign and biases P-A3.2 toward holding
